A hot-headed young nun must stop an uprising by a murderous prince prophesied to bring about the destruction of their kingdom. But there’s more to this nun than meets the eye. Philia is a young woman hiding in a child’s body -- but with the power to read minds and see visions. Meanwhile, Prince Leo of Elaion is raising a formidable army to take over his father’s throne. Eun-Jo, tired of his body feeling sore and aching, visits a sports massage shop his friend recommended. Surprised by the expensive price, Eun-Jo requests the strongest massage therapist to get his money’s worth! With just one touch from massage therapist In-Hwan, Eun-Jo’s body immediately reacts and he starts to moan!

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

145122.description:
“You’ll like him. He’s a man like Dad.”

Law firm representative In-Jun Myo lives while thoroughly concealing his true psychopathic nature. He possesses wealth, authority, and even an outwardly harmonious family. To his horror, one day his beloved only daughter, Su-Jin, introduces him to the man she’ll marry, I-Hyeon Jeong.

But in that moment, In-Jun Myo realizes that his daughter’s man is the same kind of person he is. Besides approaching the daughter that symbolizes everything In-Jun Myo has achieved, I-Hyeon Jeong has been encountered during several suspicious situations. This gives In-Jun Myo the thought that he can’t have his daughter stolen away by I-Hyeon Jeong... But it’s not easy to protect his daughter while ensuring his two-face nature isn’t discovered.

On top of that, In-Jun Myo’s innate nature gradually emerges as interference from those around him and his law firm, Noble, keeps complicating the situation.

(Source: Naver, translated)

145128.description:
Seo-An met His Majesty by chance on his way to the state exam. Having passed the exam, he is now a civil servant dressed like a concubine!? Seo-An's turbulent palace life begins!

A variety of pairings await you, such as king X civil servant, crown prince X military officer, and more! ♡

(Source: Wisdom House)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

145129.description:
Follow the sometimes whimsical and sometimes fiery journey of Seo-An, Cheong-Rok, and Cho-Yeon as they each strive to find love and romance in their lives in and out of the royal palace. A tale of loyalty, passion, and survival, Royal Love Records is a sensuous yet intense journey into a world where love is as dangerous as the throne itself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

This is Pupupu Land, a very peaceful land.
But when there is a pink, round, and hungry creature that cause rampage...
People better be prepared for the big ruckus Kirby causes!

Dr. Han Jinsoo always tried to live a righteous life, but in return, he got fired, swindled by a conman, and killed by his own professor. Luckily, a mysterious being offers him a second chance at life because of all the good deeds he had performed. The only problem is... he comes back to life as as Hua Tuo, the legendary Chinese physician, in the turbulent period of the Eastern Han Dynasty! Will he be able to survive in this era of wars and heroes as a surgeon without so much as a scalpel?

(Source: Tapas)

This guy is too serious! Even though it's a gag!

How is it possible to be funny while being serious?

Please try to read Majime seriously.

To win back the sweets, there is only one option left: to fight !!

145141.description:
"I have to spend lavishly! If I didn't, I would be disrespecting my parents' earning power!" Hong Dali may say that, but he actually has other plans. Having transmigrated into this weak and sickly body, he was gifted with the "Squander System." He can improve his physical attributes by wasting money. Say goodbye to crutches, as he spends his way to peak condition! But as long as he's wasting money, everyone will look down on him as a useless prodigal son...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

145142.description:
The Lord of The Sea — riding above the waves, calling upon the life of the seven seas, and even the beasts of the abyss listens to his callings. As the acting Lord of the Sea and possessing godly powers, I, Hai Ming, have to infiltrate the Magic Academy while pretending to be a normal student and doing ‘espionage' work?? How degrading! But for the sake of the world of magic, I have to fight back against the evil demons! I'll have to work very hard! My Lord of the Sea, please do your work!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

It turns out they’ve been captured and taken hostage by unknown people who have the intention of making two of the students participate in a “death game” where Makoto gets picked along with his classmate, Saotome. Follow along Makoto and Saotome as they unravel the truth behind the “death game”!

145151.description:
He thought he had it made when he transmigrated with a powerful system. But it turned out that to level up his system, he had to get beat up by other people. Just as he was resigned to accept the beatings, a young girl appeared and brashly asked him to become her apprentice. Tempted by the pretty loli, he accepted her offer. Hey, she'll grow up some day. But he didn't know she would grow up quite so quickly...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

145152.description:
Minako tries to inspire her younger brother, Yuu, a recluse and a NEET, to return to society by finding him a part-time job, buying him a suspicious vase, and other means. The adorable older sister is a ray of hope to the NEETs of the world with her happy face and optimistic attitude!

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

都市伝説先生ウラモン

145154.description:
The Kamijo family is a family of four living in company housing. The mother, Natsu, is told by her daughter, Yumika, to pay more attention to her appearance, but the family otherwise gets along well.

Saeki, a temp who is also a member of a theater company, comes to work for Natsu's husband, Yoshiyuki. He is such a nice and handsome guy that he got all the female employees around him all excited. Yoshiyuki asks Saeki if he can flirt with Natsu a little bit, in exchange for allowing him to live in the company housing. Yoshiyuki said, "My wife seems to have gave up on her looks, but I think she might change a little and become more feminine if she gets involved with a handsome man like you."

Saeki reluctantly accepts the proposal...

(Source: Office YOU, translated)

145155.description:
It takes a lot of courage to speak frankly about what you think and feel. But if you don't say it, nothing will change. Saitou-san is able to do such a simple yet difficult task with ease. That's why I can't keep my eyes off Saitou-san.

(Source: Office YOU, translated)

145156.description:
The continued story of Masako Saitou, a passionate housewife who hates anything crooked and is determined to always do the right thing. The new series depicts her daily life with her son, Junichi, who is now a junior high school student and is entering his rebellious phase, and her daughter, Emi, who is about to turn three.

(Source: Natalie.mu, translated)

145157.description:
Book 2 of the Seishun Buta Yarou series.

How far can a fake relationship go?

Mai is no longer invisible--she's acting again, and she finally said yes when Sakuta asked her out for the millionth time. Life couldn't be better for Sakuta...until he wakes up and finds himself reliving the morning before she agreed to date him!

Assuming this weird time slip to be another case of Adolescence Syndrome, Sakuta begins searching for clues and stumbles upon the first-year Tomoe. Though the last time they saw each other involved getting kicked in the butt, now she's desperately trying to avoid getting asked out by the boy her friend is crushing on so she won't be ostracized. One ruse leads to another, and soon news spreads that Sakuta is Tomoe's boyfriend. Now how is he going to explain this to Mai...?

(Source: Yen Press)

The ordinary office worker Ye Xiang had just finished working the night shift. In the dark stairway, he found a horror movie poster...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

145159.description:
Book 3 of the Seishun Buta Yarou series.

SOMETIMES MORE IS JUST CRAZY!
Just before summer break, Sakuta encounters Shouko Makinohara, a girl in junior high with the same name and face as his first love. Of course, that should be impossible, since she would be in college by now. Then, as if one mystery wasn't bad enough, Adolescence Syndrome strikes again. His impassive friend from the science club, Rio, discovers she has a doppelgänger. One of the Rios is forced out of her house and winds up staying at Sakuta's apartment. Definitely not the girl he expected to find himself living with...And when Mai insists she's going to sleep over, too, Sakuta's summer vacation descends into pure chaos.

(Source: Yen Press)

145160.description:
Book 4 of the Seishun Buta Yarou series.

DOUBLE TROUBLE?!

​Sakuta is eager to finally have a chance to spend time with Mai again, but instead, he's greeted by a stranger who looks just like her. Apparently, Adolescence Syndrome is paying Mai another visit and has forced her to swap bodies with Nodoka Toyohama, a flashy up-and-coming idol...who also happens to be Mai's half sister! With no resolution in sight, each sister must pretend to be the other and go about their respective lives as best they can. Trouble is, it seems like Nodoka is preoccupied with something besides walking in Mai's shoes...

(Source: Yen Press)

The invincible warrior was reborn into the body of a weakling. See how he will recover his powers and show the world, "I am the grand saint!"

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: I’m The One and Only God!

145162.description:
Book 5 of the Seishun Buta Yarou series.

GUESS WHO’S BACK?

​After years without contact, Sakuta has received a letter from his first love, Shouko, asking to meet at Shichirigahama Beach. Of course, now that he’s in a happy relationship, he’s not quite sure how to respond...or how to explain the situation to his girlfriend, Mai. Maybe he’ll just focus on helping his panda-loving, stay-at-home sister achieve her goal of returning to school for the time being. But this is easier said than done, given that she hasn’t left the house for two whole years...

(Source: Yen Press)

145163.description:
Book 6 of the Seishun Buta Yarou series.

SUPERSTRING (OF FATE) THEORY!

​Sakuta is doomed. His girlfriend, Mai, has just discovered that while she was away, he’s been living under one roof with his first love, the now-college-aged Shouko. While the three of them try to navigate this complicated love triangle, the mystery surrounding Shouko only deepens when the younger version of herself checks into the hospital. What will become of this middle schooler whose only dream is to grow up? Why did Sakuta’s old flame come barging into his life again after all this time? And exactly how does Sakuta fit in?

(Source: Yen Press)

145164.description:
Book 7 of the Seishun Buta Yarou series.

UNDOING WHAT CAN’T BE UNDONE.

Sakuta had been ready to give up his life, but nothing could have prepared him to keep living like this. Now he must find a way to carry on even when it feels like tomorrow will never come. And even if it does, why should he care when the love of his life is already gone? Of course, he can always count on Shouko to show him the way forward in his darkest hour, just like she did all those years ago. As he gathers the strength and courage Mai gave him, Sakuta readies himself to do whatever it takes to rewrite the past.

(Source: Yen Press)

145165.description:
Book 8 of the Seishun Buta Yarou series.

WHAT WILL IT TAKE TO MAKE HER WISH COME TRUE?

After a draining December, Sakuta is quickly nearing the end of his second year of high school. Since Mai is a third-year student, they don’t have much time left together before graduation rolls around. Meanwhile, his sister, Kaede, is slowly but steadily venturing outdoors again. Just as she begins to find her footing, she announces her most ambitious goal yet—attending her brother’s high school! Sakuta knows better than anyone how difficult this will be for Kaede, and he’s ready to support her however he can. He’s just not sure if that’s what’s best for her…or what she really wants…

(Source: Yen Press)

145166.description:
Book 9 of the Seishun Buta Yarou series.

Finally, the day of Mai’s high school graduation has arrived. While Sakuta eagerly waits for his girlfriend, an elementary schooler who looks exactly like her appears before him. Suspicious, and for all the wrong reasons... Meanwhile, Sakuta and Kaede’s father suddenly calls, saying that their mother wants to see her daughter. She was hospitalized because Kaede’s condition had been too much for her to bear, so what could she possibly want now?

(Source: Yen Press)

145167.description:
Book 10 of the Seishun Buta Yarou series.

Sakuta has now graduated from high school and is enjoying his new and peaceful life as a college student. One day, he bumps into the leader of the idol group Sweet Bullet, Uzuki Hirokawa. But somehow, she feels different from usual. Is the airhead able to read the room now?! However, no one notices this change besides Sakuta. Has Adolescence Syndrome affected Uzuki as well, or is it something else...?

(Source: Yen Press)

青春豬頭少年不會夢到迷惘女歌手

145168.description:
Book 11 of the Seishun Buta Yarou series.

A miniskirt-wearing Santa appears before Sakuta, calling herself Touko Kirishima and cheerfully informing him that she’s been handing out presents—Adolescence Syndrome. Apparently, one of the lucky winners is Sakuta’s classmate from middle school, Ikumi Akagi. According to urban legend, posts tagged #dreaming are filled with prophetic visions, and Ikumi is using those posts to play hero. Sakuta sees the results of this first hand when he spots her saving someone. And then a poltergeist suddenly attacks, and this is somehow his fault?! Solving all this might require delving into Sakuta’s unpleasant past...

(Source: Yen Press)

青春豬頭少年不會夢到正義護理師

145170.description:
Qianxia’s friend, Jiamei, jumped off a building because of harassment at work, and Qianxia made a deal with a devil to take revenge for her. As she investigated her friend’s death, she found a hidden camera, learned about the indifference of Jiamei’s superior, and met an oddly friendly colleague. Slowly, the truth came to the surface. This is a tale of a fight between humans, but also a fight between the supernatural. But are the supernatural the true evil, or is it what lurks in the hearts of men?

(Source: Bilibili)

145171.description:
Free-spirited Alpha Do-Gyeom has finally decided to put her promiscuous past behind her and settle down. As a 39-year-old woman, however, her options for marriage partners have dwindled. Luckily she has her beleaguered Omega secretary, Seung-Ah, to do most of the work of finding a suitable match for her. It shouldn’t be a problem, even if Seung-Ah and Do-Gyeom have harbored secret feelings for each other for years. In fact, arranging Do-Gyeom’s marriage may just be the catalyst for the two of them to finally admit their attraction…unless another Alpha gets in the way!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Chapter count includes 4 side stories.

Musical actor 'Mitch', who repeatedly fails auditions because he is Asian, lives with his childhood friend 'Rick'. Then one day, a sponsorship offer comes to him. The person who promised the sponsorship on excessively good terms was Ed, the young president of a large corporation... ?

145389.description:
Eun-Ha Cheon was just an ordinary teenage girl until she woke up one day and discovered that she was not Eun-Ha Cheon anymore, but a witch named Blythe in a magical world. Fearful of prejudice and desirous of a quiet life, she hides the fact that she’s a witch, but this becomes tricky with the arrival of a beautiful fairy who won’t stop calling her a warrior. She doesn’t want to be a warrior or anyone’s hero. All she wants is an ordinary life… But as she learns more about her identity and her world, will she ultimately get what she wants?

(Source: Tapas)

A photo posted to the page provides a hint as to the blog's owner: Tsubame, a fellow classmate known for being a lone wolf. Shouya realizes that his friend Ryuu is the object of the diary writer's affections, so he attempts to play matchmaker...but where will his own feelings take him in the process?

145393.description:
During the week, Kou Tanei works for a manufacturer. On weekends, he's an actor. One day, his colleague, Saeri Kuramoto, tells Kou she fell in love with him after coming to see his show!! The two agree to go out, but Kou is a little too protective of his cute girlfriend... which could result in the relationship hitting the rocks early! 145395.description:

His pushy father expects him to do nothing but study, so day in and out Seong-Ho buries himself in his books, oblivious to all the exciting new things happening in town. There’s one thing that’s been distracting him, though: these unidentifiable migraines that just won’t go away, no matter how many meds Seong-Ho takes. One day, after a particularly painful headache, he finds himself kissing a stranger. Horrified and appalled by his transgression, Seong-Ho immediately tries to erase that unfortunate happening from his memory. That would be the end of that, but…what if kissing is the only way to get rid of his migraines?

That man is Oomae Takao, a science researcher who is also a weirdo who claims to be "looking for love" for various reasons. Besides that, Oomae is also Akira's ex-classmate who back then had claimed to be Akira's fan.

Apparently, Oomae doesn't remember Akira at all and Akira, who was really shocked by this, swore to make Oomae fall head over heels for him. And that's how their cohabitation life together began.

145466.description:
Life is the most fragile thing. That's the world of "martial madmen".

A lone drifter, Bowie, appears in the violent city of Longshanbó. There he meets a mysterious non-human girl, Shiyu, for whom he throws himself into a bloody battle in order to save her!

A violent action work where life and death are constantly at stake!

145467.description:
Sal-Byeol escaped Min Seo-Yun, who had kept him imprisoned, by dressing as a woman. He tries to leave Joseon by using the poor nobleman Jin Geum-Seong, but his feelings grow stronger. The romance of three people entangled by fate.

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

145469.description:
Taeyoung’s always treated girls like crap. But after waking up one day to find a “lady-hole” on his ribcage, he slowly starts to gain a deeper understanding of the female experience. And luckily (or not) his ex-girlfriend is on-hand to speed up the process. Join Lizzy as she drags Taeyoung on a depraved journey of sexual discovery…

(Source: Lezhin US)

What do you do when your best friend (and secret crush) becomes a national sweetheart? This is the story of the unrequited love between a girl and her best friend, whose acting career is pulling him further and further away.

A rich man who hates children and a common woman who loves children have a faithful meeting. The two of them end up in a situation where they must raise a baby together. However, it turns out the baby is the Demon Lord's child, who might destroy the world.

145474.description:
Jiu Qiansui, the heir to the grandest sect in the Realm of Eternity, is murdered by his family's enemy after he was born. Although he is dead, his immortal body stays intact. So Jiu Qiansui goes to hell and is reincarnated as a mortal. But he is doomed to meet a disaster and he won't live to be 19. When he turns 17, he steps into the Realm of Prisoners in hope of surviving the disaster and becoming an immortal after causing a stir in the four realms.

(Source: Wecomics)

145476.description:
One day, Takeda, an overly serious model student, suddenly received a passionate confession of love from his rival Fukamachi, a frivolous elite who's top tier in looks, brains and athletic abilities. Takeda has only ever seen Fukamachi in a hostile manner and he's been going all out in rejecting the latter's persistent advances.

Then one night, he got dragged into helping Fukamachi who was out helping his private detective brother to look for a lost cat. That's when Takeda saw an unexpected side of Fukamachi who he always thought he would never be able to get along with...

This is the bumpy high school romance between a carefree, frivolous and handsome natural genius and an overly serious and straightlaced model student who just don't get along.

(Source: Kaiosha, translated)

145482.description: The twins Riko and Miko, former guests of the "Smile Duck" home, after the events that have seen them involved and thanks to the help of Professor Onizuka, decide to radically change their lives and, wanting to help those most in need, decide to join the student committee of their high school, so they can help the students of the school to solve their problems.

Being framed, Yunfei had a one-night stand with a mysterious man. After being kicked out of the house by her family, she gave birth to her daughter Zoe abroad. An e-sports champion accidentally transmigrated into another world and into the body of a spoiled heir of a family in decline. With the support of his System, he'll go on the comeback trail. With the System at hand, the world is his to command, and he will become the master of heaven and earth!

Linghudujue was supposed to be the top martial artist in the wuxia world. Stories say he defeated the demonic sect leader, cut down the Swordsman Of The East, and single-handedly snuck into Heifengzhai to slaughter 300 bandits. His exploits are legendary in the wuxia underworld, and women swoon at his name. But Linghudujue is actually hiding a shocking secret — he has no martial arts skill at all.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

145493.description:
Hyeon-Ho joins a study group to get closer to the pretty senior that he has crush on. But this study group is out of the ordinary...! A SPECIAL lesson for him begins!

"Here, Hyeon-Ho. Grab my butt like this!"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

145497.description:
Working for a counseling helpline is never boring, but when Yoochae takes one last call for the night, she learns of a company's sinister secret from the charming yet rash Sunho. Suddenly, that company's best problem-solver, the handsome Yool Sun, pays her a visit and offers her a fake job as a mental health counselor to secure her discretion. Determined to earn her keep at this cold conglomerate, the feisty but caring Yoochae opens her heart to her fellow employees and finds herself juggling the interests of both Yool and Sunho.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: The chapter count includes 3 extra chapters.

The time has come now to take action! Lucius the loser character has transformed into a villain overnight. With his new found vengeance, Lucius will set out to enjoy the action packed, harem fantasy adventure!!

145504.description:
Saki comes from a poor family and leads a boring life filled with constant studying. Her problem is that her relationship with her parents is not going well. Her parents don't get along, and Saki is caught in the middle. One day, she happens upon a group of delinquents who pressures her into smoking a cigarette. Somehow, her relationship with them turns out to be more pleasant than expected. Spending time with them makes her feel excited and alive. However, this is only the beginning of her misfortunes. A tragic suspense story about a young girl falling into the abyss.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: こんな人生は絶対嫌だ

145505.description:
Clothes, school, friends... everything was arranged by her parents, as if she was a dress-up doll.
It was a tailor who helped her find her true self.
The dresses in the store, which stands quietly in a back alley somewhere in town, shined like a beacon to her.

A collection of five stories filled with the sorrows, happiness, and joy of girls.
1. Uraroji Romanya Monogatari (裏路地浪漫屋物語)
2. True me! (True me!)
3. Katawara no Hoshi (傍らの星)
4. 15-fun no Rin Niwa (15 分の厘庭)
5. Samei no Akari (察明の灯り)

(Source: girls×garden comics, translated)

145507.description:
Su-Han still misses his ex-girlfriend Ju-Ri, who left him without saying goodbye. One day, Su-Han runs into Ju-Ri, who is now his boss's fiancé. What will be the fate of the three...?

(Source: DAYcomics)

145509.description:
Summer holidays a middleschooler and his home teacher will never forget.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 魔王がずっと見ている

145511.description:
Ruru Ogawa, a high school girl, is told that she has a "blood affinity," a special constitution that we once called "vampires." Ruru is sent to work with Ed, a “blood lore master” who can absorb the memories of the people he sucks blood from. A fantasy story where memories of traditional crafting skills are passed on through blood!

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)

145512.description:
I-Seul, who lived in regret and guilt after her father's sudden death. A boy flying in the sky appeared in front of her.

"I'll give you a little courage."

(Source: Naver, translated)

145513.description:
Being a beta in a world where alphas and omegas were destined for each other, Azuma had long accepted that there was no such thing as 'fate' for him. Still trying to get over a heartache from the past, he meets 'Mahoro' by chance one Christmas night. Pitying Mahoro's unfortunate state, Azuma tries to offer help, despite being flustered. While Mahoro refuses Azuma's offer to stay at his house, he invites the latter to drop by his workplace as thanks. It turns out that Mahoro works in a brothel. As Azuma gets more drawn to Mahoro, he finds out that Mahoro is looking for someone: his fated partner. Against his better judgment, Azuma decides to help Mahoro.

(Source: futekiya)

title.native: シティ・ライツ・バースデイ
呪って呪ってそれから愛して

145515.description:
Shuuhei, a reporter for a trashy tabloid magazine, becomes obsessed with Nao-kun, a mysterious amateur ghost-hunting streamer who secretly works as a camboy on the side - and after he attempts to meet Nao in real life, things take a turn for the bizarre when he tries to understand more about the lonely, slutty boy.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

145517.description: "A romance comic with a slightly unusual setting" - from the Author's Twitter post

145518.description: One night, Kazuho, a hotel worker who possesses a rare blood-sucking constitution, helps a drunk man he found lying on the side of the street by giving him a place to spend the night. The next day, instead of waking up to the man he brought back to his apartment, Kazuho unexpectedly finds a dog sleeping in his bed!

145521.description:
Usokui is a manga one-shot created by Sako Toshio, in 2005, for Weekly Young Jump's 48th Manga Grand Prix competition. It won an honorable mention and was later published in the 48th issue of the magazine, that same year. The one-shot serves as a prototype for what eventually became Usogui.

Note: Republished in split-up sections as side stories for volumes 12-15 of Usogui as Igyou Tobakusha Usokui.
synonyms: 異形賭博者 嘘喰い

145522.description:
Corporal Nathan goes missing yet again on a field exercise. His beloved Captain comes to retrieve him, and their treck back begins!! With Nathan wallowing in despair at his hopelessness, what's a Captain to do...?

(Source: MANGA.CLUB)

145523.description:
Three dull boys suddenly awaken to supernatural powers. However, even though they become psychics, their ordinary life continues.

Note: Published in Harta Magazine's Terang Winter 2022 issue.
synonyms: Our Extraordinary Days Have Just Begun!

145525.description:
Jeong-Min is a loner in high school being bullied by the Queen Bee, Ju-Hyeon. The two were friends in elementary school before their friendship ended because of Ju-Hyeon’s demand that Jeong-Min should only be friends with her. Ju-Hyeon uses this “betrayal” to fuel the classmates' insults and isolate Jeong-Min in misery. Jeong-Min has only one way to escape, through lucid dreams. One day, a mysterious man enters her dreams and offers to help her get revenge on Ju-Hyeon…

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.
synonyms: ฝันหวานสานรอยแค้น

145526.description:
In middle school, when Outa had to move schools, he told his best friend, Tomoaki, but all that Tomoaki had to say were the cold words, "It can't be helped." Outa was expecting him to say that he would miss him, and he was so shocked that he ended up moving schools without even saying goodbye. Time has passed since then, and Outa is now in college and determined to enjoy his student life on his own. One day, he ran into Tomoaki, whom he did not want to meet again. Outa found it awkward, and tried to put some distance between them, but Tomoaki kept talking to him for some reason!

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Hana Saku Bokura no Koi Wazurai

title.native: 花咲く僕らの恋わずらい

145528.description:
Would you confess your love for someone if it meant saving your life? Well, that's what I did. I’m a ghost named U-Min, and my girlfriend is a ghost hunter. Quite the cliche, I know... Honestly, I don’t know how I’m gonna get rid of her, but I can’t just let her kill me, either!

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

145530.description:
One-shot released in commemoration of the movie release, about Tsubasa and Daisuke as university students.

(Source: natalie.mu, translated)

title.native: 青空エール 特別編

145531.description:
A girl walks alone in a world without humans. Her mission—to search for survivors and cleanse the land. But is anyone still out there in the lonely, beautiful ruins, waiting to be found?

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Los confines de la oscuridad - Misión en el apocalipsis

title.english: The Color of the End: Mission in the Apocalypse

145532.description:
Han Si-Woo lost one leg when he was young. He was bullied in school and stigmatized by people who met him. Using a “smart leg”, he started skateboarding and after displaying excellent balance and skills he managed to join the “extreme crew”. He has to overcome his rivals and obstacles in his way. Will Han Si-Woo be able to overcome all these things and prove that he is capable to participate in the national team selection?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

145534.description:
Hayden Grummond Fildette, the only son of Count and Countess Fildette, was the perfect heir and lovable anchor who kept his family together. But the peaceful days come to an end when an unwelcome guest from his father’s past surfaces, threatening Hayden’s position with a possible half-brother and tipping over his parents’ precarious relationship. Will he and his family be able to withstand the storm of uncomfortable truths and misunderstandings, or sink in the raging conflicts?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 伯爵家の招かれざる客たち

title.english: The Unwelcome Guests of House Fildette

145535.description:
If the sexy toys you ordered for “research” end up at your neighbor’s house, and your neighbor happens to be a gorgeous actor willing to help you test them out, well… It’d be a waste not to, right? Shy BL author, Eujae Lim, just wanted to live a quiet life, but Jinhoo Park wants to be his male lead.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes three extra chapter.

145536.description:
Denis, who lives off the rich, has a trashy life together with his lover, Hugo. But he gets kicked out after getting caught for wasting all his money on gambling. Before Denis finds a new rich to live off on, he steals a bag for his living expenses.

As he ran away with the stolen bag, he bumps into the partner of the bag's owner 'Yoon-Hwan'.
Yoon-Hwan sees the keyring on the stolen bag Denis was holding and misunderstands him as his partner.

As soon as Denis sees him, he can tell that Yoon-Hwan was quite wealthy. So he decides to pretend he is his partner...

'What is this.... Do I really like him? Because he's my type?'

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

145537.description:
Essie Ash can see how and when people will die. One day, she finds an injured man in her backyard and discovers that he is Prince Pell. To her shock, she notices that her parents' and other residents' death dates have moved up since Pell's arrival. Essie asks him to leave, hoping things will change, but changes her mind when Pell saves her from his brother's assassins. She soon decides to join him on his journey to the capital, but can't help but wonder why she's the cause of his future death...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ฉันเห็นความตายของนาย

145538.description:
Life is about survival of the fittest... But what do you do when you're reborn as a crow? Find someone big and strong to take you in, of course! After saving Prince Camute's life, Rainelle is brought to the imperial palace to live as his pet. However, just as she believes she's set to live a life of comfort, she finds herself caught at the center of a dangerous power struggle between Prince Camute and his brother. Now that her survival depends on his, will Rainelle find a way to help her prince?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.
synonyms: Of all things, I Became a Crow.
よりによってカラスになってしまった
ทำไมฉันต้องกลายเป็นอีกา

145539.description:
I, The Supreme One has returned, after four years, the grudges from 4 years ago must be avenged, I will kill anyone who gets in the way of my revenge, no matter if it’s a demon, god, or heaven itself, they all will perish under my wrath.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

145540.description:
The Qin clan's son-in-law Yang Fan was looked down by everyone. In the face of all the humiliation, he gained the Twin Cultivation System, which allowed him to gain revenge by cultivating his medical and martial skills simultaneously. Now he's a medical expert, a martial artist, and super handsome, too...! Even if he only married into the family, Yang Fan was determined to become the strongest son-in-law in history.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

145541.description:
What happens if a modern, straight guy time travels to an ancient world where women are superior to men? His new, powerful mother had been expecting a daughter but ended up giving birth to him. So, guess what? He's been forced to be a drag queen ever since!

(Source: Webnovel)

145542.description:
It gets lonely when you have no equal. It's no fun when you're too strong. The bustling city in the mortal realm looks a lot more interesting. This is the adventure of a divine master in disguise.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

145543.description:
An intense guilty pleasure presented by five artists. Enjoy the thrill hidden inside the uniform.

1-3. Poguga Geuchineun Nal (폭우가 그치는 날) [Hu-Ung]
4-6. Ibeojuseyo Hangyeongjangnim! (입어주세요 한경장님!) [KR]

10-12. Overheat (오버히트) [Chamji]
13-15. Mission Escape (미션 이스케이프) [Silver]

145544.description: The story of junior high school students' new outlook on life. It's an inspiring tale of the many issues in our modern society. And the undue pressures of society to conform their standards instead of being yourself. For those who dealt with issues such as bullying, weight, and appearance.

145546.description:
Yeong-A Lee has always been called “the guillotine.” Whether it’s chopping up boys' hearts in school or cutting out incompetent employees at her current job, she is the definition of ruthless. The only sense of “love” she has ever given is through playing her favorite dating simulation game. After clearing her third run-through, Yeong-A is sent a device that allows her to actually enter the game as the main character. But there is a catch. All of her save data thus far has been added in, meaning she is currently dating three out of the four male leads! To make things more complicated, Yeong-A can’t leave the simulation until she finds her true love. That is where the final male lead and Yeong-A’s favorite, Ren Brecht, enters the scene. Unfortunately, when it comes to affection, Ren just might be as merciless as Yeong-A…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ways to Break Up with the Male Lead
เลิกกันเถอะ พระเอกเกมที่รัก

title.english: How to Break Up in a Romance Simulation

145548.description:
You're still precious to me.

After losing her family in a demon attack, Rosha is reborn as the 777th most powerful magic knight in the Golden Dawn Society. To avenge her family, she trains hard and rises through the ranks against the odds. Then, she is tasked with protecting little Joshua, who is said to be the Child of God...

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: The Golden Dawn Light Will Shine For You

145549.description:
Ning Shu had dropped dead. But fortunately, she became an agent to help poor cannon fodder characters overcome their fate. So Ning Shu played different kinds of life roles in alternate universes, encountering all sorts of troublesome characters like transmigrated or reincarnated protagonists. Ning Shu has to painstakingly recover each character's dignity in one world after another.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

145551.description:
When Jiwon, a 37-year-old cancer patient, walks in on her husband and best friend, she realizes her whole life has been a lie. What’s worse, she dies a tragic death at the hands of her husband. Would things have been different if she had made different choices? Fortunately for Jiwon, she is given the chance to rewrite her fate when she is reincarnated as her younger self. This time, she vows to live a happy life. But first comes revenge. Her plan? To marry off her now former best friend to her lying, cheating husband.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.
synonyms: สามีคนนี้แจกฟรีให้เธอ

145552.description:
A sliver of remnant soul snuck through the fingertips, and thus Li Tianqing began the journey of recovering glory for the Li clan!

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

145558.description:
Aurora Fenryr Astrophotas, the Goddess of War, returns from the seven-year war to face the aftermath of her father’s mysterious illness and subsequent death as well as the four men vying for her hand in marriage. Her best friend’s lover, her loyal fan’s fiancé, a professor with a secret, and her ex-fiancé come before her, but will she find a husband in time? She yearns to return to the battlefield, but instead, she must evade bedchamber intruders, power-hungry nobles, the haunting illness, and most importantly… her own heart.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes the prologue.

title.native: かみがみ〜最も弱き反逆者、異世界チート勇者を討つ〜
title.romaji: Kamigami: Mottomo Yowaki Hangyakusha, Isekai Cheat Yuusha wo Utsu

145561.description:
Unloading his lust onto the girl who's so close to him...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic X-Eros #94

145562.description:
In this world, a new alien species named Humanoids or "noids" roam the earth, indistinguishable from regular humans. However, the full moon triggers a transformation in them, though the shape they take differs between each noid. As such, noids are ostracized by society. Near seems to be one such noid and suddenly appears in the mountains where Keiji lives. With no identity and no memories, Near (named "Near" by Keiji) has nowhere to go. Keiji opens up his secluded home in the mountains to Near, knowing full well that what he was doing was a criminal act. But Near doesn't seem dangerous, and Keiji would love the company. It can get so lonely up in the mountains...

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra

145565.description:
This is Rumiko Takahashi at her darkest, but her trademark humor and romance also pop up in this three-volume series. Legend has it that if a human eats a mermaid's flesh, they will be granted eternal life. But is that a blessing or a curse? Immortal lovers Yuta and Mana travel through Japan and the centuries longing for a normal life. On their journey, they meet others who have consumed the flesh of a mermaid in hope of becoming immortal. But the powerful substance affects each person differently. 145590.description:
It's the end of the world as we know it - or is it?

Gorgeous, confident, and demanding, Haruhi Suzumiya is the leader of the SOS Brigade, a club comprised of her high school's most extraordinary students. So when Haruhi is bored, it's up to the SOS Brigade do something about it. In this sequel to the clever and uniquely witty The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya, the SOS Brigade goes along with Haruhi's scheme to make a movie for the school's upcoming festival. But when filming begins, strange things start to happen, and Haruhi-who has no idea she's a goddess with the ability to destroy the world-starts to show her devastating powers.

Could the end be near? Or is it just another day at high school? You never know when Haruhi is involved!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes a prologue and epilogue.

145591.description:
This third volume in the Haruhi Suzumiya series is a collection of four exciting short stories that take place before The Sigh of Haruhi Suzumiya.

1. Suzumiya Haruhi no Taikutsu (涼宮ハルヒの退屈, The Boredom of Haruhi Suzumiya)
In her latest attempt to give the SOS Brigade more public exposure, Haruhi signs them up for the city-wide baseball tournament.

2. Sasa no Ha Rhapsody (笹の葉ラプソディ, Bamboo Leaf Rhapsody)
It’s like Back to the Future! To prevent an impending disaster, Mikuru takes Kyon back in time, where he meets Haruhi during her middle school years.

3. Mysterique Sign (ミステリックサイン)
The computer club president mysteriously disappears, and it’s up to the SOS Brigade to get to the bottom of it!

4. Kotou Shoukougun (孤島症候群, Remote Island Syndrome)
It’s vacation time when a relative of Itsuki’s invites the SOS Brigade to stay at his island villa. But when a dead body turns up, Haruhi and the gang naturally get involved in a thrilling murder mystery.

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes a prologue.

145592.description:
WHAT IF YOU WOKE UP ONE MORNING, AND EVERYTHING HAD CHANGED?
It’s one week before Christmas Eve, and Haruhi and the rest of the SOS Brigade are gearing up for holiday festivities. But just before the fun kicks off, Kyon, the only “normal” member, wakes up in a weird alternate dimension, one where Haruhi attends another school entirely, Nagato the time traveling robot is just an ordinary human, and Mikuru (the cute girl of Kyon’s dreams) doesn’t even recognize him—in other words, the SOS Brigade never existed.

The only clue Kyon can find is a bookmark left by the robot version of Nagato, which leads him on a quest back in time, where he once again encounters the events of “Bamboo Leaf Rhapsody,” a short story from the previous Haruhi book, The Boredom of Haruhi Suzumiya. This fun and quirky holiday tale is reminiscent of A Christmas Carol and It’s a Wonderful Life.

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes a prologue and epilogue.

145593.description:
WHAT HARUHI WANTS, HARUHI GETS!

​Stunning, brash, and completely clueless about her powers, Haruhi Suzumiya can make anything bend to her will. Although she doesn’t know it, she’s a goddess who has the ability to destroy the world—so don’t make her mad! Luckily, she has her SOS Brigade (a club comprised of her high school’s most extraordinary students) to keep her happy. This fifth volume in the wildly fun and unpredictable Haruhi Suzumiya series features three short stories for Haruhi’s every mood—an endless (looping) summer, a heated (overheated) competition with the computer club, and a ski trip getaway (with a dangerous blizzard!).

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes three prefaces for each short story.

145594.description:
HARUHI SUZUMIYA, the fierce and fabulously spontaneous leader of the SOS Brigade (a club for her high school's most extraordinary students) is always a magnet for wild adventures (and trouble). Now get ready to go back in time in this sixth installment of the series! Five short stories reveal never-before-seen events from the SOS Brigade's past exploits, from the much-anticipated school cultural festival to unanswered questions about the ski trip getaway. The last story, which brings back the SOS Brigade to the present, rounds out this collection of entertaining, hilarious, and, as always, unpredictable mis-adventures. Anything is possible in Haruhi's world!

(Source: Yen Press)

145595.description:
BACK TO THE FUTURE IN ANOTHER ADVENTURE FOR THE SOS BRIGADE!

​It’s a new year, and Haruhi Suzumiya, the powerful (and pushy) leader of the SOS Brigade is actually…content. For once, she’s not seeking out time-traveling exploits, murder mysteries, or any other wild adventures that could lead to the destruction of the entire world. Surprisingly, it’s Kyon, the most normal member of the SOS Brigade, who wants to shake things up. When Kyon discovers that something’s not right with the universe, it’s up to him, his pal (and secret crush) Mikuru, and the beautiful but stoic Nagato to head back to the past in order to save the future. Join the frenzy and fun with this seventh book in the phenomenal bestselling series that took the world by storm.

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes a prologue and epilogue.

145596.description:
Two stories continue the adventure in Volume 8 of the Haruhi Suzumiya series.

1. Henshuuchou ★ Itchokusen! (編集長★一直線！, Editor-in-Chief, Straight Ahead!)
Since the beginning of the year, the SOS Brigade has been masking as the Literature Club to be recognized as an official high school organization. But when the new student council president threatens to disband the group, the members must write a collection of literature. Naturally, Haruhi assume the role of editor-in-chief and leads the team to publication with hilarious results.

2. Wandering Shadow (ワンダリング・シャドウ)
From writers to detectives, the SOS Brigade does it all. When fellow classmate Sanaka comes to the club seeking help, the team (well, Haruhi) is up to the task. A well-trodden popular park path has suddenly begun to terrify the neighborhood dogs, and Haruhi suspects that its being haunted by animal spirits. It looks like the SOS Brigade is about to perform its first first canine exorcism!

(Source: Yen Press)

145597.description:
HELL HATH NO FURY LIKE HARUHI SCORNED…

​As the new school year begins, Haruhi’s cynical and sarcastic confidant Kyon, the only “normal” member of the SOS Brigade, is reunited with an old friend from Kyon’s days in junior high. Haruhi and Sasaki’s shared friendship with Kyon—and, possibly, shared abilities—causes tension between the two girls, and Kyon knows Haruhi’s dissatisfaction can have dire consequences! This chance meeting could change the future for Kyon, the SOS Brigade, and even the entire world. The latest volume of Haruhi Suzumiya’s unpredictable tale shakes things up with two version of the same story, each with a different ending. Join the frenzy and fun of the phenomenal bestselling series that took the world by storm.

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes a prologue.

145598.description:
WHERE HARUHI GOES, TROUBLE FOLLOWS!

​The two-story lines from The Dissociation of Haruhi Suzumiya continue! A new member joins the SOS Brigade who may be more than just the eager freshman she appears to be. As the dual realities converge, the club members quickly realize that their latest recruit may have the ability to unite both timelines...and save the world in the process. Join the frenzy and fun of the phenomenal bestselling series that took the world by storm!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes an epilogue.

145599.description:

After all, Haruhi has a tendency to turn even the most mundane events into impossible uproars! That danger could not be more apparent than when their club activities lead them into the world of school wonders and whodunit mysteries. Even peaceful moments are remarkably eccentric when Haruhi is around...

She runs so much her shoe breaks. Luckily, the local shoe shopkeeper, Takumi Kobashi, comes to her (shoe’s) rescue.
Saddened that Wakaba can never find cute shoes in her larger size, the young cobbler proposes to make shoes designed with her feet and size in mind. Surprised but happy, Wakaba gladly accepts to help out the young man, but what will Wakaba do when the glass slipper fits?

Enter Valia Dean, who just overcame her second near-death experience as a destitute orphan. In order to save Karl, the senile mercenary who raised her in her late parents' absence, Valia volunteers to marry Marquess Shuden Gartt, whose reputation for massacre pales in frightfulness to the coldness of his gaze. Valia, hardened by misfortune, orphancy, starvation, and betrayal, accepts what seems to be certain death. Even in marriage, she will not love. It won't matter how handsome, rich, gentle, chivalrous, and caring he is, or how lovingly he behaves as her husband, right?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.
synonyms: 神殿贡女要从神女手里抢男人？

145633.description:
Li Chu transmigrated to Shilipo and became an ordinary Taoist. In this world filled with ghosts and demons, he was content to stay safe in Shilipo and live an ordinary life. Until one day he was forced to get involved with the wuxia world. And then he found out that you can solve most problems in this world with one slash of the sword. And if one slash won't do it, try two.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

145634.description:
On the first day at his new job, Ji-Ung ends up falling in love at first sight with his immediate boss, Kim Sang-Ha. He vigilantly looks for a chance to get closer to him, but is disappointed when he hears that Sang-Ha is currently mourning his dead lover. Then one day, when Ji-Ung is driving drunk Sang-Ha home, he suddenly feels his body slipping away…? Goodness, how do you deal with the aftermath of having sex with someone while being possessed.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
synonyms: I was Possessed by Your Ex-Boyfriend

145635.description:
Love-dependency Syndrome, commonly known as "yandere". I have a special constitution which naturally attracts that type of people.
Before I tell you my story, let me first get off this operating table.
“I won’t let you run away”
“You’re mine”
“No one else can have you but me!”
“We'll be together until we die, promise!”
The girls’ words, they still echo in my ears.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

145636.description: A novel that delves into the eight main characters, showing the trauma that they have suffered in their respective pasts and how they matured and turned their eyes to the future.
synonyms: Kiznaiver: That Day’s Wounds, the Future Bonds

title.native: 小説　キズナイーバー　－あの日のキズ、これからのキズナ－
title.romaji: Shousetsu Kiznaiver: Ano Hi no Kizu, Kore kara no Kizuna

145641.description:
Yukinari, a yakuza bear loyal to his boss, gets seriously injured and ends up being the caretaker of his old man's only daughter," Lady Sayoko".
Sayoko is quiet and mature for her age, but she is a princess with bad eating habits who does not care about food!
Yukinari is worried about her eating habits and tries to get her to eat delicious, nutritious food, in one way or the other…!
A delicious heartfelt story of a fluffy caretaker and a little girl.

title.native: しろくまヤクザと悪食姫

145642.description:
He always thought he was just an ordinary guy, but he didn’t know that his yard was full of divine artifacts and the chickens he raised were actually phoenixes! It wasn’t until after five years of living in an ordinary village when the System finally allowed him to come into contact with cultivators. It was then that he discovered that no matter how strong someone was, the moment they saw him, they would be so intimidated that they would tremble in fear. Some would even kneel down and call him master…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

145643.description:
Stories of other people's real-life sexual experiences that you aren't suppose to sympathize with. The popular site that received over 20,000 submissions, over 10-million views, and sold 120,000 books has now been adapted into a manga in an "emotionally sensitive" way by Tomo Tagawa!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 純猥談 一度寝ただけの女になりたくなかった
title.romaji: Junwaidan: Ichido Neta Dake no Onna ni Naritakunakatta

145644.description:
The manga centers on two women: Kyouko, a regular accounting department office worker who is around 40 and who maintains another life as the belly dancer Sali, and Akari, a likeable 23-year-old temp worker and colleague of Kyouko who is seeking marriage. Akari is convinced that her youth and cuteness are her only merits, so she is seeking to find a partner by going to mixer after mixer, perceiving her time as "running out" while feeling empty and lonely. A certain incident leads her to finding out about Kyouko's double life as a belly dancer, and she slowly begins admiring Kyouko.

(Source: Anime News Network)

synonyms: The Assassin Can't Kill the King

145646.description: Note: Aika to Oji-san Soushuuhen released in 2022/07/16
synonyms: あいかと叔父さん 総集編

title.native: あいかと叔父さん～寝ている間に花嫁修行～
title.romaji: Aika to Oji-san: Neteiru Aida ni Hanayome Shugyou

title.native: やさしい教師の躾けかた。

145648.description:
Hyeon-U is an ordinary office worker whose life couldn't get any more boring. His new life begins with the sound of a message beep...

"Engage in intercourse with a female employee, fail to do so and lose a month's salary."

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

title.native: 食料生成スキルを手に入れたので、異世界で商会を立ち上げようと思います
title.romaji: Shokuryou Seisei Skill wo Te ni Ireta node, Isekai de Shoukai wo Tachi Ageyou to Omoimasu

145651.description: A man with a particular fetish fears how his impulses and sexuality will ruin those he loves. He sentences himself to a life of celibacy, but one day, he receives a confession from a man he has secretly loved for years. His resolve now crumbling, will he be able to protect his lover from himself?

title.native: 僕が僕であるためのパラダイムシフト
title.romaji: Boku ga Boku de Aru Tame no Paradigm Shift

145655.description:
A desert island with ancient beasts, modern humans, future technology as well as chaos in space and time. This is the place where the rapid development of desert island civilization takes place, from the stone age, the age of energy to the age of electricity. Living on an uninhabited desert land and starting up a system, Qin Tian tries to survive by starting from scratch. A school belle, a blonde-haired lady, and a ballistic loli - I want all of them. Whether it’s taming the golden eagle, snaring the king of a wolf pack, or making a python retreat, I am in charge of this desert island!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)
synonyms: Survive on a Deserted Island With Beautiful Girls
我和妹子们的荒岛余生
サバイバルマスターになりました
Sobrevivendo em uma Ilha Deserta com Garotas Lindas

title.english: Desert Island Survival with the Ladies
title.native: 荒岛余生之时空流浪纪
title.romaji: Huangdao Yu Sheng Zhi Shikong Liulang Ji

145656.description:
Takamine-senpai is cool, beautiful, and good at her job, the unattainable flower of the office.

Nono, who agrees to go out with Takamine, is an ordinary straight girl.

But Takamine has a secret......

(Source: Brick Shuppan, translated)
synonyms: Takane no Hana to Futuu no ko

title.native: 高嶺の花とふつうの子
title.romaji: Takane no Hana to Futsuu no ko

145657.description:
Rikako asked her tutor, Tomoya, "If I get a perfect score on the next test, would you kiss me as a reward?"

"If you get 100 points on your review test, I will kiss you wherever you like."

He kissed her on her forehead, cheek, and.... Rikako became more and more greedy for his kisses until she couldn't hold back anymore and confessed love to her teacher. She got an unexpected reply, "I like you too!"

"We're going to do things that aren't just for rewards. I'll teach you everything I know." Rikako was confused by this unexpected reply, but...?

(Source: Love Jossie, translated)

145658.description:
Finding the perfect guy isn’t easy, but looks like Eunseo just hit the jackpot. Seung-hyuk’s a handsome, hot hunk with a pretty face that anyone would fall in love with. How could you resist someone like that, especially if they feel so much like Mr. Right? Well, as with any good thing, there is a small catch. Apparently, Seung-hyuk is a friend’s ex-boyfriend. Not just any friend, but Eunseo’s new roommate, Minjae. What a fix. Eunseo wants to keep on meeting this hottie, but hurting his friend’s feelings isn’t right, right? Even if the hottie lives next door and they literally run into each other all the time? Right?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

145659.description: Third year master’s student, Wang Juo Chun, by chance picked up a flower with a face. The flower not only can talk but the voice is exactly the same as his ex-girlfriend! One day, the flower began to persuade him to kill...

145660.description:
When he woke from his slumber, the Night King found himself resurrected! It has been 300 years, his disciples that he trained through efforts have now attained immortality and grown up, each beautiful and elegant! “300 years… 300 years! It is my turn to tease…No, guide you all!”

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: My Apprentices Are All Female Devils

title.english: My Disciples Are All Hot Badasses

145661.description:
Ye Yun traveled through the martial arts world full of gods, devils and demons, and became the patriarch of the Divine Dragon Sect. After 100,000 years of secluded cultivation, he came out from his fraudulent tomb with god-like techniques, skills, and weapons which stunned his disciples. But one person’s invincibility will not be enough to make the world submit, it takes a strong group of people to make the world tremble! So Ye Yun will lead the Divine Dragon Sect to once again become the strongest sect, able to sweep the heavens and conquer ten thousand realms, rising up to defeat all who stand in their way!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

145662.description:
Lu Cheng was cursed to transmigrate into a world without a cultivation path towards immortality. He became the person who triggered the apocalypse. On the verge of death, a mysterious power system was activated. Lu Cheng was determined to take advantage of it to change his fate, by overcoming trials and tribulations in order to level up! The trial of the sun, the trial of the moon, the trial of absolute death.... will he be crushed by the ten thousand trials? Or will he defeat them to rise up into the heavens? The path to immortality starts with overcoming these calamities!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: Beginning From Passing Through the Calamity

145663.description:
Arima Nijo's an alpha working at a top-ranking company. Ever since he was in middle school, though, he's only been able to fall in love with other alphas. Now, he disguises himself as an omega and works as an escort at night. Even if only for a few moments, pretending to be an omega fulfills him...

One day, after a client cancels on Arima at the last minute, he meets Koki Izumi, a man whose appearance is just his type. Izumi's a college student who's also a famous entrepreneur, and while he can be pretty arrogant, he's great in bed. Even though it was a one-night stand, Izumi was Arima's ideal alpha. Three years later, Arima reunites with Izumi and introduces him to... their son, Ayumu! Due to Arima's unique biology, he is able to give birth, and he wants Izumi to take responsibility...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: คุณอาริมะอยากเป็นโอเมก้า
Arima Wants to be an Omega

title.english: Arima Wants To Be An Omega
title.native: 有馬さんはオメガになりたい

145664.description:
Reborn as the daughter of a count she read about in a novel, Lady Valeta knows the story ends in tragedy at the hands of her lowly house pet, Reinhart. Having never wanted him in the first place, Valeta tries but fails to oust him from her house. But when Reinhart’s powerful magic is awakened one day, he kills all those around her, and it is now Valeta who is at his mercy. Though the tables have turned, Reinhart can't shake his attachment for Valeta. He lets her live, but only within his grasp.

(Source: Tapas)

Notes:
- The side stories are rated R19.
- Includes 41 extra chapters.
synonyms: I Failed To Throw The Villain Away
วายร้ายผู้นั้นที่ฉันไม่อาจตีจาก

title.english: I Failed to Oust the Villain!

145666.description:
Jae-Hyeon has always gotten everything that he wanted, but the housekeeper's son, Eun-Hae, was the one person that he desired above anything else. So when Jae-Hyeon heard that Eun-Hae's moving away, of course he's going to push him down the stairs. Eun-Hae loses his memory due to the accident, and Jae-Hyeon decides that he will never desire anything ever again. However, an unexpected reunion with Eun-Hae triggers Jae-Hyeon's desires to come rushing back...

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 食料生成スキルを手に入れたので、異世界で商会を立ち上げようと思います
title.romaji: Shokuryou Seisei Skill wo Te ni Ireta node, Isekai de Shoukai wo Tachi Ageyou to Omoimasu

title.native: ジョーク・デ・ジョレイ
フライング・ダーウィン

145671.description:
Rabby Johnson’s sure got it all. (At least, he thinks he does.) He’s the best bounty hunter in all of the universe, he has great friends, he’s got it going on. Just one thing: he’s been saving up his ass for the perfect gentleman of his dreams. But it’s a disaster in hell when he drunkenly loses his virginity to this mysterious hunk… who turns out to be a real pain in the ass. Rabby was waiting for the one, but he sure wasn’t ready for this jerk who turns his life inside out…

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 花菱一家 大夏祭り
高校生WEB作家のモテ生活　「あんたが神作家なわけないでしょ」と僕を振った幼馴染が後悔してるけどもう遅い
title.romaji: Koukousei WEB Sakka no Mote Seikatsu: "Anta ga Kami Sakka na Wakenai desho" to Boku wo Futta Osananajimi ga Koukai Shiteru kedo Mou Osoi

145674.description: A series about a young couple and their first child.

145675.description:
“I recommended Master Beryl as the knights' special instructor.”

In a village in the remote countryside, Beryl Gardinant meticulously runs a fencing dojo. One day, he's paid a visit by his former pupil Allusia, now grown into the kingdom knights' commander, and Beril decides to follow her to the royal capital to become a special instructor for the knights. As he's pulled into reunions with his accomplished and eager apprentices, what does fate have in store for Beryl?

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: An Old Man From the Countryside Becomes a Swords Saint: I Was Just a Rural Sword Teacher, but My Successful Students Won't Leave Me Alone!

title.english: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman: My Hotshot Disciples Are All Grown Up Now, and They Won’t Leave Me Alone
title.native: 片田舎のおっさん、剣聖になる ～ただの田舎の剣術師範だったのに、大成した弟子たちが俺を放ってくれない件～
title.romaji: Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru: Tada no Inaka no Kenjutsu Shihan datta noni, Taisei Shita Deshi-tachi ga Ore wo Houttekurenai Ken

145676.description:
Ever since his brother's wedding, Ichiya is romantically obsessed with Natsuki, his brother-in-law. After the passing of his brother, he moves in with a widowed Natsuki to help raise his nephew...

Note: Chapter count includes three extras.
synonyms: I Think of You at Night

145678.description:
Katra, a girl with a big heart and an even bigger appetite, is adopted (or abducted?) by the chief of a flourishing all-female village in the mountains and becomes one of her many brides. But her co-wife Mihri has hidden feelings for Katra and can't stand seeing her with another woman. Things get even more complicated when a hunter from a far-off land appears and develops a crush of her own. Can Katra keep everyone happy, or will she have to choose?

(Source: Fakku!)

145679.description:
1. Koubi de Shitsukero!: Hatsujou Nyan Nyan (交尾で躾けろ！発情ニャンニャン); Comic Unreal 2018-08
2. Takane no Ano Ko wo Inma Sennou (高嶺のあの娘を淫魔洗脳); 2018-12
3. Hypnosis Tengu (ヒプノシステング); Doujinshi
4. Seiso na Miko ni Toritsukeba Ogehin Kaika no Oto ga Suru (清楚な巫女に取り憑けばお下品開花の音がする); 2019-04
5. Juken Hisshou!: Saimin Kojin Lesson (受験必勝！催眠個人レッスン); 2017-06
6. Challenge! Hentai Majo Rensei (チャレンジ！変態魔女錬成); 2018-06
7. Nurunuru Aesthetic de Onitaiji (ヌルヌルエステで鬼退治); 2017-12
8. Namaiki Succubus ni Kyuusei se yo! (生イキサキュバスに給精セヨ！); 2017-02
synonyms: 発情ケダモノ交尾録 種付け
おじさん語録かるた付き限定版

145681.description:
Today, just trying to make a living is all I can do.......

No regular job, no savings, no boyfriend... The boy that suddenly appears in front of Mirai, a girl living in poverty, is her own son who has time-traveled from the future! Can she raise her child while pursuing her dream of becoming a successful actress? Can she safely send her son back to the future? And who exactly is the father......? A never-before-seen home-life love comedy about the life of a suddenly single mother is about to begin!

(Source: Young Jump, translated)

title.native: 未来のムスコ ～恋人いない歴10年の私に息子が降ってきた！
title.romaji: Mirai no Musuko: Koibito Inaireki 10-nen wo Watashi ni Musuko ga Futte Kita!

145682.description:
The "Child of Araragi Incident", a mass murder that would later send shockwaves through society.
Desperate to solve the mystery, Detective Masato Seto forces an unauthorized sting operation. But just as he grasps a fragment of the truth, he commits an irreversible mistake...
"Can a sin ever truly be atoned for?"
Centered around a rehabilitation ward, this is a story of true recovery for both mind and body. A groundbreaking new medical manga begins here!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 境界のエンドフィール

145683.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2019 November issue.

145684.description:
Yun-Seul appeared in Sae-Byeok’s life for a brief moment, then disappeared like a fleeting sunshower. But mysterious circumstances have brought her back to the human world and into Sae-Byeok’s life once more. She needs to reclaim what was once hers. And in order to get it, Yun-Seul needs something from Sae-Byeok that’s more important now than ever: his love.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

145685.description: The journey of a pair of siblings, Dan-Yeong and Dan-Ri who seek revenge against the arch-nemesis of their parents.

145686.description:
The child who disappeared 15 years ago has returned. A psychological investigation into the disappearance of a child by a police officer with superpowers.

(Source: Naver, translated)

145687.description:
Yang Shan is good at online comments which is also his job. His famous quotation is "Even a dog can do better than you if it travels back in time."One day, a system makes this come true and sent him to a place called Otherworld, and he was reborn into a Goldie dog...

(Source: Wecomics)
synonyms: Rebirth of a Golden Boy in Another World

145688.description:
Wang Yiyi was a regular, busy comic artist who lived from deadline to deadline. When the male lead from her comic, CEO Leng Ziye, came to life in front of her, he was certain Yiyi was the female lead from the same comic. Unable to convince him otherwise, and without any idea how to make him disappear, Yiyi reluctantly began living together with the fictional CEO of her creation!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: Living Together With a Fictional CEO
title.native: 总的来说，和纸片霸总合租了
title.romaji: Zong De Lai Shuo, He Zhipian Bazong He Zu Le

145689.description:
Transmigrating into the world of Tianxuan, he became the master of a weak martial sect! The notorious pay-to-win player was reborn inside the world of his favorite game. He'll make the other players into his underlings and take on the game's main character as his apprentice. In this universe, he's going to make a name for himself as the No. 1 in the world!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: Keep a Low Profile, Sect Leader

145690.description:
Arranged to be married as children, Su Xiaoxiao and Xu Yichen begin a secret relationship as husband and wife. As they spend more time together, their romance blossoms. However, many twists and turns await. Will their marriage have a happy ending?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

145691.description:
Xiao En, who was working on a virtual world learning machine, died in an accident, and got isekai-ed to a magical world with the learning machine (AI) that was a slut in the inside but has a pure elder sister appearance. The time in the virtual world learning machine’s space is ten times slower, and with this endless time, it can surely create the greatest new generation of outstanding masters!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: I Practice Magic in Another World

title.romaji: Wo Zai Yi Jie Xiu Mofa

145692.description:
When Jiang Beiran's transmigrated into a world of cultivation with a System, he thought he had it made. But the System turned out to be a pain in the ass, full of unreasonable demands! Fine, he will just do things his own way, cultivate on his own and concentrate on survival. Ignore those rumors about a mysterious hero and his sycophants. He doesn't want anything to do with it! However, this world and this System may not turn out to be so simple…

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: I Just Don't Play the Card According to the Routine

title.romaji: Wo Jiushi Bu An Taolu Chu Pai

145693.description:
The young Huo Yuanzhen crossed the alien world and became a minor faction—the Shaolin Abbot’s commandment. In order to save his life and complete the task of the "abbot system", Huo Yuanzhen had to start to find ways to make Shaolin believers more and more prosperous. The rise of Shaolin made the surrounding factions panic. They secretly tried to suppress Shaolin, but they were beaten by Huo Yuanzhen. The strength of Shaolin and Shaolin abbot even attracted the sons of the royal family.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: Building the Strongest Shaolin Temple in Another World

title.romaji: Dazao Yi Jie Zui Qiang Shaolin Si

145694.description:
Despite being the young lord of Merak Palace, Yi Tianyun is considered a weakling and an outcast by all those around him. The only person who cares about him is the master of the palace and his aunt, Shi Xueyun. After another day of training without much progress, Tianyun receives a special dragon blood elixir from Xueyun to replenish his health. But upon consuming it, he’s thrown into the “Frenzy Leveling Up System,” which allows him to finally gain the boost in power he’s always wanted. Now armed with a trove of incredible skills and items, is there any opponent who stands a chance against him?

(Source: Tappytoon)

145695.description:
Recent graduate Jin has been assigned to help out his upperclassman Seto, a highly competent but somewhat standoffish systems engineer. Though Jin is good at his job, he does seem to have his head in the clouds more often than not... and Seto's eyes always seem to linger on him more than they should!

A fresh new boys' love office romance in which opposites attract!

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: カットオーバー・クライテリア

145696.description:
High school mukbang streamer who specializes in spicy food.

One day, while looking at the necklace her mother gave her, she falls asleep. When she wakes up, she finds herself in the body of a poor girl, living in the Joseon Dynasty…

(Source: Copin Comics)

145697.description:
Cheng Shan, a mysterious one-armed young man, travels around the world with his companion, a young girl named Ming Cai, in search of a miraculous medicine, the "Faded Dragon Scale". The theft of the black umbrella from the imperial palace resulted in heavy sins. Due to past relations to the black umbrella, Cheng Shan and Ming Cai decide to search for the black umbrella and recover it. However, after several twists and turns where their lives were in danger, they find that the matter is not as simple as they thought. Will Cheng Shan finally be able to unravel all mysteries and distinguish good from evil? Will he be able to escape unscathed from the lethal threats and dangers lurking in every corner, and eventually find the Faded Dragon Scale? dragon? Or, is there a greater conspiracy behind this? In this life, he is destined to be unable to hide and have no other option but to fight with his life because he is... The Craftsman.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

145698.description:
Hana is a shy and unassuming office lady. She had a secret crush on Otsuka, the handsome and popular leader of the sales separtment, but it seemed impossible to talk to him! Then one day, she attended an IRL gathering for her favorite online game, and to her surprise, Otsuka was there, too! It was awkward at first, but she enjoyed talking to him so much that she ended up getting drunk. She thought it was a dream, but when he was so sweet to her, as he repeatedly rubbed her most sensitive parts, she felt so good she couldn't think about anything else... An elite man's sexy doting will take over her mind and body!

(Source: Renta, translated)

title.native: 泣いても絶対、やめてやんねぇ～エリート男子の溺愛攻略～
title.romaji: Naitemo Zettai, Yamete yan Nee: Elite Danshi no Dekiai Kouryaku

145699.description:
In a vast and wild world, the martial arts culture was still in its formative stage. Yi Yun accidentally transmigrated with a purple crystal that could quickly absorb the "energy" of cultivation. With his arrival in this world, the legend of the True Martial Art will begin.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

145700.description:
No cultivation resources, and penniless, too? It doesn’t matter, I have a mirror, and whatever I see with the mirror, human or beast, dead or alive, anything could be duplicated by its projection. Whatever martial arts tomes, heavenly treasures, divine weapons, even talents and skills can all come out of this mirror! Ding! "The Seven Stars Soaring Cloud Technique" just dropped! Ding! Canglan Battle Armor! Ding! Advanced Gold Talent! My name is Feng Yun, and I'll speak for myself.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

145702.description:
God’s Identity Card: Lu Lanqiao, a forensic science student, became the most likely suspect in the murder of his elder brother overnight. His brother's last words put him on the run. While trying to find out who killed his brother, Lanqiao met Fu Cheng, the police inspector who was hot on his trail. However, the relationship between the fugitive and the pursuer gradually changed…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

145703.description:
The Super Jealous Tsundere System swore he doesn't even like the man he's attached to, but it often gets angry and do rash things out of jealousy. Our main character may look like an experienced playboy, but he's actually never even been kissed. Together they'll jump into different worlds to punish all the bad guys in style.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: I Suspect the System Likes Me

145706.description:
Opposites inside out. ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten BEAST 2022-03

title.native: ヤりすぎバックシュート

145710.description: Arai's attempt to court his savior, the bar manager Okabe, is relentless. It all began the day when Okabe saved him from a tangle with a hoodlum. Despite his flirty reputation, Arai was in fact an absolute beginner in love. Okabe kept refusing his advances until he finally suggested a one-night stand with the university student. A sensual, yet lovely story between a frivolous-looking student who's seriously in love, and a well-built, older bartender!

title.native: お兄さんのこと、好きなの?

145711.description:
Ever find the one that got away? Ha-Rim and Eun-Ju are old high school classmates who never got to fulfill their desires of being with each other. After graduating, they went their separate ways. But one day, they bump into each other and old flames get rekindled. Things are about to get hot and heavy, but there’s just one thing. The quiet island town of Onobori is hidden from the world by a Noren — a traditional curtain that veils it from the ordinary. Here lives Aka, a gentle, innocent girl living in a windmill coffee shop with her grandfather. Life flows peacefully, until a chance encounter with a giant black cat draws her into a subtle, spellbinding journey. As moments of quiet beauty unfold around her, Aka begins to stitch together the vibrant threads of a future shaped by kindness, connection, and wonder.

145922.description:
A mysterious camera that shows the future. Ghost lights of unknown origin. And people slipping into unexplainable comas. This is all the information detective Seo Sungmin has as he pieces together the mystery of his girlfriend’s vegetative state. But investigations hit a standstill when he’s found with blood on his hands… Now on the run, will Sungmin be able to solve this supernatural case and bring the real criminal to justice?

(Source: Tapas)

145923.description:
Are we bound by the fate of our blood? Or do we possess it within ourselves to change our destiny? Growing up between families as a child, Dora Blunt is elated when she finally finds a place to call home in the arms of her distant aunt, Grace Blunt. Grace, having forfeit custody of her son Jack after she was deemed unfit to be a mother, views Dora as a way to correct the mistakes of her past - a gift from the heavens themselves. The two grow closer and closer, and it seems to Dora that she finally has found the place she belongs. But when Jack returns to Grace’s care, Dora finds herself experiencing mixed emotions: jealousy tinged with curiosity, joy entangled with fear, and perhaps most intensely of all, a desire to be wanted. As she feels herself being pushed back into the familiar shadows of neglect, Dora must do whatever it takes to gain control of her path in life and stay in the light.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

145924.description:
Fuminori Sakisaka, a young man who lost his family in a tragic car accident, has his life saved through an untested surgical procedure. However, thanks to a strange side-effect, all that comes upon his eyes appears twisted and ugly. All except for the beautiful girl who goes by "Saya", who draws the color of beauty to Fuminori's stained existence. For him, she is the only strand of light still remaining in life.

As a high school student and aspiring artist, I desperately wanted to paint like her.
Yuri Kashiwazaki, the girl who is regarded a "genius," no matter what she draws.

"I just came by to see you. I only paint when I want to."

She is my childhood friend, at once the closest and furthest person to me. One day, she just stopped painting, but I remained in her shadow and continued to wield my paintbrush.

"I'm going to keep painting. I won't give up. I won't use talent as an excuse."

Until the day when Yuri starts painting again. Until the day she will admire my paintings.

This is the story of an ordinary boy who devotes his youth to art, to challenge a "genius."

As the trust in their friendship cracks and reveals hidden depths underneath, Jeong-oh must navigate his rapidly changing relationship with Yeong-won—which is going to be infinitely harder with Ha-yeon entering the picture.

145940.description:
I, Maehara Maki, someone who couldn’t make any acquaintances or friends in high school, finally had someone I can hang out with outside of school. A girl.

Her name was Asanagi-san. The boys in my class called her ‘The class’ second cutest girl’ behind her back.

On Fridays, she would refuse her best friend, Amami, ‘the cutest girl in class’ invitation just to hang out in my house with me.

Together, we played games, watched some movies, read some manga while eating junk foods like pizza and hamburgers, and chugging cola without a care in the world. To others, we may seem sloppy, but it was a precious, secret time together for Asanagi-san and myself.

Note: Volume count includes a collection of short stories numbered as Volume 7.5.
