145941.description:
Shiraishi Gomichi, an ordinary high school student, has a secret. He has a memory of his previous life. In another world, different from this one, Morimichi was a ‘hero” who saved humanity. However, this is only the story of his previous life. In this life, it was supposed to be a normal student life, but the appearance of Mai Shiina, a girl who transfers into his class, changes his ordinary life. She is also reincarnated like Gomichi, who once was a witch who once plunged the other world into disaster. They had battled each other many times in their previous lives, but when Gomichi asks her what she wants now, Mai tells him.

“I can’t live without you!”
“What… ?”

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Won Honorable Mention in the 11th Lanove Bunko Newcomer Award.

145943.description:
Raised by his strict family of five older sisters, Noa leaves home to become an adventurer in a faraway land. But despite being a supposed novice, he keeps shocking seasoned adventurers with incredible feats of strength and magic. It’s no wonder, really. Unbeknownst to Noa, his sisters are some of the strongest people in the world—masters of magic, swordsmanship, trade negotiations, and more. While his sisters think of Noa as worthless, the rest of the world sees him for what he truly is: a whiz! Determined to forge his own path, Noa begins his new life where he’s finally appreciated for his abilities. But what will happen when his overprotective sisters set out to bring him home? If worth is in the eye of the beholder, Noa is here to prove this whiz has been hiding in plain sight all along!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

145944.description:
“Here unfolds the story of an OP unparalleled Rookie!!”

Noah was raised by his exceptionally capable older sisters. He leaves his home to the nearby city to become an adventurer, but every time he performs he shocks those who witness him with wonder... “Wait? Am I actually strong...?” He really shouldn’t be surprised by his abilities when all five of his older sisters that raised him are the worlds greatest in their respective fields! He has unbelievable potential! Here begins Noah’s shining new life getting the acknowledgment he deserves, but his older sisters are chasing after him...? He who was supposed to be inept is actually a super rookie! Noah’s life as an adventurer begins!!

(Source: Comikey)

145948.description:
"You will die in 100 days."

Duchess Lelouche received the prophesy from God. Her fiancé, the Crown Prince, has been distracted by other women and is said to be on the verge of breaking off their engagement... And even if Lelouche knew the future, she still couldn't change the fact that she was going to die. But she can change the way she dies, and the effects of her death - or so she was told. So she made a bet with God.

"If I may die beautifully, please reward me."
"If you do good. I will give you whatever you want in your next life."

Now Lelouche will act to support the family she is leaving behind, and fight the "conspiracy" that will lead to her eventual death...

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

title.native: 100日後に死ぬ悪役令嬢は毎日がとても楽しい。

145949.description:
In the kingdom of Famille, there was a viscount named Martinez. This minor noble house, possessing no lands, had three daughters.

The second daughter, Fabiola Martinez, has eyes the color of a lamp flame and walnut-brown hair. By herself, she is a lovely young lady.

But when all three sisters stand together, Fabiola appears ordinary in comparison. Her elder sister, two years her senior, is an alluring beauty, with a stunning figure. Her eyes are vivid, ruby-like red, her hair straight and glossy black. Her appearance captivates anyone who lays eyes on her. Her younger sister, two years her junior, is a delicate girl who evokes a protective instinct in everyone she meets. Her eyes are a bright, pale pink. Her hair is a soft, wavy, light brown, like the color of faint fragrance.

This is the story of the middle child, caught between these two irresistibly captivating sisters, finding her own happiness.

(Source: GA Bunko, translated)

145950.description:
Life hasn't been kind to Zenos. He was born in the slums, and his dirt-poor background has denied him almost every opportunity. After an encounter with a healer, he throws himself into studying to become one and finally catches a break when an adventurer invites Zenos into his party. Zenos is thrilled—so thrilled, in fact, that he's willing to put up with his teammates treating him like garbage. They fail to appreciate his talents and ultimately kick him to the curb, claiming he's outlived his usefulness to them.

Now bereft of money and out of options, Zenos decides to put his self-taught skills to use elsewhere and opens an underground clinic. Word quickly spreads about the brilliant healer working incredible magic in the city's shadowy underbelly. Even the royal palace is taking notice...

Can Zenos buck the odds and carve out a life for himself in a world that's done nothing but spit in his face? And can he save the lives of the patients who wind up on his doorstep in the process?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Ryoka is an office lady who is liked by everyone, but due to her sadist fetish, she hasn't been with anyone for a long time. She's the kind of woman who wants to make men squeal, and she's approached by a younger colleague who's cute as a puppy!

145960.description:
Cursed to stand alone against monstrous creatures called Tengu, Mamoru Yamaemori is ready to sacrifice everything if it means keeping his younger brothers safe.

In the mountains above Japan, Mamoru Yamaemori spends his days tending to his family shrine, fighting Tengu— monsters who feast on human flesh—and, making sure his two younger brothers will never have to pick up his mantle. Unable to escape the life forced upon him by his parents and a dark ritual involving Tengu blood, all he knows is that his existence is a curse: he is destined to die young in the service of others.

But to fight monsters, Mamoru must dance that line between loving older brother and mindless beast – or else he risks becoming that which he is sworn to destroy.

(Source: Titan Manga)

Jorace, a warrior, is on the road to success.
Marriage to an unidentified, super-cool, handsome man has come.

145962.description:
There’s an old rumor about the Schravant’s mansion. That a dark devil will, one day, come to take away the beautiful master of the house. It seems to be nothing more than fanciful thinking, but how does that explain the change that Mihael brings when he barges into the Schravant brother’s lives? The devil will find what Evan and Victor Schravant desire, even if they desperately try to suppress those urges. They say the world’s a stage—what play will these dark souls enact?

(Source: Lezhin US)

145966.description:
When a goddess transports Hansoo Kang and his classmates to a magical fantasy world to become heroes, it’s like a dream come true. But when Hansoo declines to risk his life for a world that isn’t his own, the goddess leaves him for dead, alone in the forest. That’s when he realizes she’s not what she seems. With the help of a loner god, Hansoo faces the hostile new world and earns powerful blessings to help him survive. But his goal isn’t to save the world; it’s to return home… well, after he gets revenge on the goddess that is.

(Source: Tapas)

145969.description:
“Please help! I’ve been kidnapped by this man. Please call the police!” Just like any other night, Hye-Seong spends his time playing games with an online friend, Nana. But when Nana goes AFK and accidentally leaves his mic on, Hye-Seong hears the voice of a panicked girl crying for help, saying she’s been kidnapped. Once Nana gets back, he sounds suspicious of Hye-Seong, even asking questions that sound like he’s trying to gauge Hye-Seong's reaction. Despite Hye-Seong trying to act as natural as possible, Nana insists on meeting IRL…

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Three hundred years after the Great Cataclysm of the Fairy Continent, the demons gradually awakened. The Seven Divine Artifacts that could save the Fairy Continent appeared in the world. By chance, two teenagers from the Three Domains of Humanity obtained the Peerless Pearl, one of the Seven Divine Artifacts, which gave them the power of symbiosis. The demons were searching for the seven artifacts, trying to strangle the hope of redemption in the cradle. The two boys fearlessly embarked on the road of adventure, as they hoped to unite the races of the fairy continent against the powerful demons, and buying time for the development of the weaker human race...

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 10 extras.

145980.description:
Megumi Miki is a single woman who has always kept her otaku hobbies to herself!
She wants to have a friend to talk to about her favorite characters... So she tries to arrange an IRL meetup with her SNS follower... only to have an intimidating yakuza man show up!
She feels like her life might be in danger, but when she actually talks to him, she finds that he is a true hard-core otaku!
He may be a bit touchy about the proper coupling, but he's fun to be around and he's surprisingly reliable!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Cheon Muji-Chee, the only son of the Hebei thousand swords family and the grandson of King Kwon. Cheon Seong, the lazy young master of the heavenly swordsman. He wants to become an imperial scholar, but the world pushes him to the top.

“My dream is to become a scholar….
How long do I have to be like this?”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

145983.description:
Mov Saga Online is an MMORPG based in virtual reality. Zerry has been a player since the game’s early days, yet he’s still stuck as a low-level novice. That’s because the idea of running through dungeons and completing quests has never interested him. He’d much rather stay cooped up in his virtual home, eating snacks all day. However, his gaming life takes a one-eighty when he suddenly stumbles upon a rare weapon that grants him exclusive access to an epic quest! With the encouragement and anticipation of his friend, Tana, Zerry finally begins leveling himself up to take on the challenge. But this epic quest will soon turn out to be much more than both players bargained for…

(Source: Tappytoon)

145984.description:
The mighty Leon has long ruled over Dark Fall. But when he mysteriously loses his powers, his obedient followers turn into dangerous enemies. And it isn’t simple revenge that they’re after. Instead, they want him to bear a new king of Dark Fall in his womb, while becoming their plaything in the process. Soon, Leon’s budding libido is stimulated for this very purpose, and Dark Fall’s once-great ruler is brought to his knees.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Editor's Comment: This comic contains violent sexual content that some readers may find uncomfortable.

145986.description:
Nan Zhi's day life life is riddled with success and admiration. After work hours, however, her search for a romantic connection of any kind runs rampant. Bored by every encounter she's had, the entertainment company CEO is shocked when a one-night stand imprints itself on her mind. And she's even more shocked when she learns the subject of her infatuation is her best friend's younger sister.

(Source: Tapas)

145987.description:
Despite loving music, Xiaochao avoids playing the piano because bad things happen whenever she does. One day, however, she gives into temptation and plays the piano at her school. Not only does her melody shatter a window, but it also attracts two boys, Michael and Tod... who happen to be an angel and a grim reaper! Xiaochao learns that they're both on a mission to restore the shattered genesis piano, a powerful treasure of the cosmos that keeps the world moving. What's more, her music has the power to awaken the genesis piano's keys that have scattered throughout the world and lie dormant in people. Both Michael and Tod want Xiaochao's help in restoring the piano, but Xiaochao isn't sure she wants the crazy responsibility of saving the cosmos. Will she decide to step up to the keyboard, even if it means attracting superhuman enemies in the process?

(Source: Tappytoon)

145988.description:
Chu Xingchen time travelled to the immortal cultivation world, thinking he could lie down peaceful to enjoy his new life, but he was forcibly bound by the strongest martial god system, and was forced to start the road of his cultivation.

(Source: Mangatoon)

145990.description:
Can't there be friends among male and female? HO-JUN and YU-HA are very close, but never seen each other as a man and a woman. But, the day before HO-JUN went into the military, something happened. In an awkward silence, YU-HA suddenly makes a move and kisses HO-JUN. This turned on HO-JUN's switch... "We're not actually dating, but we treat each other as if we are... Are we a thing?"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

145991.description:
Natsuko has no choice but to move into her company-owned housing while her previous apartment building is being renovated. Little did she know, her new crib is actually a shared house!! She's now living together with the hottest guys in the company, Osuke and Toya... Things take a sudden u-turn after both of them kiss her.

They want her to date them both...!! Looks like they're going to learn to share a lot more than just living arrangements!

(Source: Renta!)

Haruka's staying at her brother's place while she goes to college. Unfortunately, her peaceful days are ruined by his friend, Iori Tsuga! He's always wearing loose shirts that show off his bare chest, and it drives Haruka up the wall. It's obvious he's trying to seduce her, and every time she sees him in his underwear or getting out of the shower, she's tempted to complain about him to her brother... But, lately, she finds her heart racing whenever Iori makes a pass at her...! Will the pure and innocent Haruka succumb to Iori's overpowering allure!?

In addition to this cover story, "My Brother's Friend Likes to Flaunt It," this volume contains a brand new short story starring the same characters! 145995.description:
Daiki Kurosu is just an ordinary high school boy. He worries about his grades and doesn't mind how his little sister likes to mess with him. However, Daiki feels like something is missing in such a normal life. One day, Daiki felt intense palpitations coming from a strange girl on the street. She is a witch from another world, living in hiding...! The long-awaited manga adaptation of the Kakuyomu contest-winning novel "Irinoku" has begun!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
